help.label: Help with {feature}
help.guideDescription: Start with setup, then prepare email and manage replies and meetings.

workflow.title: 1. Prepare connections
workflow.body: Connect a mailbox and configure SMTP. For meetings, prepare a calendar, meeting type, and host availability.

workflow.title: 2. Prepare contacts and content
workflow.body: Add companies and contacts, check consent and suppressions, and create a template with personalization, booking, and unsubscribe variables.

workflow.title: 3. Review and send
workflow.body: Choose recipients, a channel, and a template. Freeze the campaign, obtain required approval, and execute it.

workflow.title: 4. Check outcomes
workflow.body: Check job results in Operations, replies in Inbox, bookings in Meetings, and unsubscribes in Suppressions.

dashboard.summary: The starting point for reviewing work, email activity, approvals, and meeting status in Office.
dashboard.when: Use it to decide what needs attention today.
steps: Review the status cards for sending, approvals, and meetings.
Open the relevant feature for an item that needs attention.
Check its details and recorded outcome before moving on.

companies.summary: Keep company records together with their contacts, internal owners, notes, and activity.
companies.when: Use it to manage relationships at the company level.
steps: Create a company and enter its basic details.
Link its contacts and assign an internal owner.
Add notes and activity as the relationship develops.

contacts.summary: Manage the people you communicate with, including their email, company, owner, and history.
contacts.when: Use it to prepare recipients or find an existing customer.
steps: Add a contact directly or through an import.
Verify the email, company, and internal owner.
Check consent and suppression status before choosing marketing recipients.

inbox.summary: Read conversations from connected mailboxes, assign an owner, and prepare reply drafts.
inbox.when: Use it when a customer replies or needs follow-up support.
steps: Connect a mailbox in Mail accounts first.
Open a conversation and assign the responsible person.
Prepare a draft and review the required approval and sending status.

templates.summary: Save reusable email subjects, content, and personalization variables. Saving a template does not send email.
templates.when: Use it to reuse a message layout with different recipients.
steps: Create a template and open a new version.
Write in the email canvas or toggle to HTML; insert name, booking, and unsubscribe variables.
Preview and save, then select that version in a campaign or draft.

campaigns.summary: Prepare a sending job that combines selected contacts, email content, and a delivery channel for review and execution.
campaigns.when: Use it to send one prepared message to a selected group.
steps: Prepare a mailbox and channel, then enter a campaign name and objective.
Choose recipients, a template version, variables, and a meeting type when required.
Check timing and limits, freeze the reviewed content, and request approval.
Run the approved job when requirements are met and inspect results. SMTP acceptance does not prove inbox delivery.

approvals.summary: Review a proposed action and its recipients before approving or rejecting execution.
approvals.when: Use it for human review between preparation and execution.
steps: Open the request and inspect the sender, recipients, content, and frozen evidence.
An eligible reviewer records a reason and approves or rejects it.
The requester checks the result and proceeds with available actions. Requests requiring a separate reviewer cannot be self-approved.

meetings.summary: Review booked meetings, change or cancel their time, and record attendance outcomes.
meetings.when: Use it to manage bookings from your email booking button.
steps: Set up a calendar, meeting type, and host availability first.
Issue a booking link or insert the booking button into a template.
Review bookings and manage changes, cancellations, and attendance.

meetingTypes.summary: Define the name, length, buffers, and booking window of a meeting such as a consultation or introduction.
meetingTypes.when: Use it to create the meeting choices offered in links and emails.
steps: Prepare the signed-in host’s calendar in Settings.
Create a meeting type with a name, duration, and booking conditions.
Set host availability, then choose an active type in booking links or campaigns.

agents.summary: Review agent principals, research runs, and proposals, and follow work requests within their allowed capabilities.
agents.when: Use it to monitor agent research and proposals. Manage agent credentials under Members & agent access.
steps: Review registered agent principals and their status.
Inspect research proposals and run details.
Request permitted work and review results. Agents cannot replace a required human sending approval.

imports.summary: Add contact or company data in bulk from files such as CSV and review the processing result.
imports.when: Use it to bring an existing list into Office.
steps: Prepare column names and required values such as email addresses.
Select a file, check column mapping and preview, then request the import.
Review processing status and errors. Importing a record does not establish marketing consent.

compliance.summary: Manage unsubscribe and suppression records for addresses that must be excluded from sending.
compliance.when: Use it to check that an unsubscribe or sending exclusion is applied.
steps: Search for an address and inspect its current suppression state.
Review requests received through the unsubscribe link and their recorded results.
For a required change, verify the evidence and use the available authorized review process.

complianceReviews.summary: Review the evidence and requests that establish a basis for contacting a person.
complianceReviews.when: Use it when consent or communication evidence needs review before marketing.
steps: Find the contact and the evidence requiring review.
Open the request and inspect its evidence and reason.
Record an authorized review result and verify it in the sending preparation flow.

operations.summary: Inspect progress, failures, and results of background work such as imports, sending, and booking processing.
operations.when: Use it to investigate work that appears stalled or failed.
steps: Find the job for the relevant time and status.
Inspect its details, errors, and external-effect information.
Use only retries offered by the screen and check the outcome. Do not manually resend an uncertain external operation.

operationsIntegrations.summary: Inspect delivery channels, calendar connections, their availability, and review records.
operationsIntegrations.when: Use it to check whether a configured connection is ready or needs repair.
steps: Review connection status and any reauthentication requirement.
Check delivery purpose, review history, and channel availability.
Fix credentials or settings in the related setup screen, then check the status again.

settings.summary: Manage workspace members, connections, compliance rules, and operational tools from one place.
settings.when: Use it to set up Office and review the controls behind daily work.
steps: Open Members to manage workspace roles and invitations.
Configure mailbox, SMTP, and calendar connections for email and meetings.
Review policies, security, compliance, imports, agents, and background operations as needed.

settingsMembers.summary: Manage workspace members, roles, agent principals, permissions, and MCP service credentials in one screen.
settingsMembers.when: Use it to maintain team access and manage MCP credentials for agents.
steps: Review each member’s name, role, and status.
An authorized administrator adjusts roles and account state as needed.
Manage agent principals and scopes, then issue or revoke MCP credentials. Review mailbox access under Mail accounts.

settingsMailAccounts.summary: Configure Office mailbox connections, SMTP delivery, and mailbox-specific permissions.
settingsMailAccounts.when: Use it to prepare the mailbox for replies and the path for sending.
steps: In a fresh workspace, connect a mailbox to create an Office mail account first.
Configure the SMTP server, TLS, and login, and choose a supported sender address or alias.
Verify connectivity and compose/send grants, then choose the campaign delivery channel.

settingsCalendars.summary: Prepare an Office internal calendar or a supported external calendar for storing meeting bookings.
settingsCalendars.when: Use it before creating meeting types and booking links.
steps: Prepare the Office internal calendar or configure a supported external connection.
Confirm the current host has an active calendar.
Configure meeting types and availability. Internal bookings do not create external calendar invitations.

settingsPolicies.summary: Review and configure shared workspace conditions applied to sending and other actions.
settingsPolicies.when: Use it to manage the team’s common limits and review conditions.
steps: Read the currently applied settings and their explanations.
An authorized administrator updates the required values and saves.
Check that the campaign review reflects the new conditions and limits.

settingsSecurity.summary: Inspect account sessions and manage access that is no longer needed.
settingsSecurity.when: Use it to review your current login and other sessions.
steps: Check the current session and other sessions’ sign-in times.
Identify unused or unrecognized sessions.
Use the available session termination action and verify the resulting state.
